report.heading: Your wellness plan
report.intro: Based on your answers, your body needs extra support in 7 key areas. Your full plan is below, with the breakdown at the end.

products.name: Renew Glucosamine Complex
products.why: You told us about bone density with age and joint stiffness or discomfort. This one is a multi-nutrient blend.
products.description: A compound found in cartilage, usually made from the shells of shellfish.

products.name: Focus Quercetin Complex
products.description: A plant pigment found in onion skin, capers and apple peel, paired here with the vitamin C it is usually taken alongside.

products.name: Peak Creatine Complex
products.why: It matches your bone & joint health goal.
products.description: Stored in muscle and supplied in small amounts by red meat and fish. Monohydrate is the form nearly every study has used. Creatine increases physical performance in successive bursts of short-term, high-intensity exercise. The beneficial effect is obtained with a daily intake of 3g of creatine.

products.name: Core Daily Vitamin D
products.why: Your answers suggest your vitamin D3 intake is below your target, and you told us about bone density with age and joint stiffness or discomfort.
products.description: Vitamin D3 with calcium, the mineral it exists to help the gut absorb. Vitamin D contributes to the normal function of the immune system and to the maintenance of normal bones.

products.name: Renew Collagen Complex
products.why: Your answers suggest your vitamin D3 intake is below your target, and you told us about bone density with age and joint stiffness or discomfort. It is a source of protein, which contributes to the maintenance of normal bones.
products.description: Marine collagen built out with the vitamins and minerals skin and joints draw on, so it stands alone rather than beside a multivitamin. Vitamin C contributes to the normal function of the immune system and to the reduction of tiredness and fatigue.

products.name: Renew Curcumin Complex
products.why: You told us about joint stiffness or discomfort.
products.description: The yellow pigment in turmeric root, and the reason curry stains. It absorbs poorly alone, so black pepper extract usually travels with it.

products.name: Renew Turmeric Complex
products.why: You told us about bone density with age and joint stiffness or discomfort. This one is a spice extract.
products.description: Whole turmeric root with ginger and black pepper, the combination most kitchens already use together.

report.macros_note: Your intake is estimated from your height, weight, age and activity, then adjusted for your portion sizes and how often you skip meals. It is an estimate of a typical day, not a record of what you ate.

rows.name: Vitamin D3
rows.sources: Sources: eggs, vitamin-D-fortified foods and UV-exposed mushrooms. Food alone rarely covers vitamin D, particularly in winter.

notices.title: Talk to a professional
notices.text: Joint swelling with stiffness that lasts into the morning is worth seeing your GP about, as it can mean something other than ordinary wear. (If a joint is swollen or red, or stiffness lasts over an hour in the morning)
